readings.section: 2.4 Radiation Laws: radiant flux, irradiance and radiant exitance

changesZh: 核对通量、辐照度、出射度，明确光子到达率需乘每光子能量才能得到瓦；其余角度与谱单位是本站推导。
changesEn: Check flux, irradiance and exitance; photons per second require photon energy to become watts. Angular and spectral-unit derivations extend the textbook introduction.

changesEn: Retain SI units, Planck spectral quantities and integration conditions; the site develops the derivations beyond the textbook overview.

changesZh: 补直接辐射、漫射照明、路径辐射和邻近效应表；核对水汽分子与水滴区别、散射弱不等于零。
changesEn: Add direct/diffuse illumination, path radiance and adjacency effects; separate water-vapour molecules from droplets and weak scattering from no scattering.

en: Reflection geometry, Lambertian surfaces and BRDF

changesZh: 加入同一波长和角度约定下的吸收—反射—透射守恒；反射因子可大于1，保留辐亮度/强度与单位区分。
changesEn: Add matched-convention absorption/reflection/transmission conservation; reflectance factors may exceed 1. Retain radiance/intensity and unit distinctions.

readings.section: 2.6 Fluorescence; Spectral Properties of Objects; Figure 2.19
1.5 Radiation–Target Interactions: leaves, water, spectral response

changesZh: 增加反射、荧光与热发射区别表，避免将荧光混同红边或把波谱视为永久指纹。
changesEn: Distinguish reflection, fluorescence and thermal emission; fluorescence is not the red edge, and spectra are not immutable fingerprints.
